summary: Single-engine air tanker (Air Tractor AT-802A, CO Fire Aviation) crashed at ~6:37pm on 2021-11-16 near the south end of Hermit Park southeast of Estes Park while fighting the Kruger Rock Fire; pilot Marc Thor Olson, the sole occupant, was killed. Wreckage located ~9:49pm after ~3-hour search by fire crews and emergency officials.
location: South end of Hermit Park, southeast of Estes Park (Kruger Rock Fire)
notes: Date/time exact per LCSO release (crash reported 6:37pm 11/16/2021; wreckage found 9:49pm). Single-engine Air Tractor AT-802A air tanker on first-ever Colorado nighttime fixed-wing firefighting drop; pilot Marc Thor Olson (CO Fire Aviation), sole occupant, killed. Fire crews + emergency officials responded searching ~3 hours in mountainous terrain. incident_type 'other' (no aircraft category). Corroborated by LCSO release; LCSAR post is a shared news link (real-org post, standalone source).
